first_pass_desc: A larger grey semi-transparent copy of the building fades in behind and above-left of the small building. Machine saw it as sub-threshold.
Man replaced by a single yellow bond certificate at centre-left on empty white. Machine saw partial change.
Bald green-shirt man laughing, one arm waving, appears at right, large and cropped at the bottom edge; dollar sign and bond remain.

Hard cut at 4919 (frames 4920-4921 hold): finished bond timeline replaced by a lone black-haired figure with furrowed brow and flat mouth, one arm raised, centred. Machine motion class wrong; it is a cut.
Cut from chalkboard to a build-up: big analog clock appears left with spinning hands, then money-bag pile, then grey LAW document pop in; a smiling figure rises in front of the clock at bottom-left.
Text unchanged ('Today this thing is'); the thick black typing arm switches from bottom-right to bottom-left. Machine additive class wrong: this is the arm alternation.
Left figure's bubble removed and a smaller 'On it!' bubble appears by the right-hand wordmark, whose limb raises a thumbs-up. Machine additive class wrong; this is a swap.
Tooltip pill ('Dictate' shortcut) with mic buttons appears under left panel; timer 00:03; right panel text grows to 'Hi Ana'. Machine local-animation class: it is a tooltip pop-up.
Tooltip replaced by a black recording pill (close and confirm icons) under left panel; timer 00:06; right panel text 'Hi Ananya,'. Machine class local animation; this is a widget swap.
Left panel fills with full dictated email text while the scene zooms onto it; 00:30 timer and a big green check appear. Machine global-motion class is really a zoom.
Left character's face changes from a relaxed glasses-smile to a worried open-mouth frown with head turned; laptop marked CF and the 'bee tea eye' bubble at right stay unchanged.
Tiny cursor changes in the demo: text caret appears in left pane and a hand pointer hovers the mic button in right pane. No layout change.
Carets blink off in both panes and the mouse pointer sits at the right pane's left edge; no content change.
Right pane text grows to 'Notes from the...'; left caret fades.
Right pane dictation grows word by word to 'Notes from the call with a Narnia one'; left pill waveform animates.
Right pane text extends to '…corrected 1099'.
Right pane line one fills with 'but it's still' and a second line begins to appear.
Second line extends to 'missing too her'.
Second line extends to 'is handling the'.
Second line extends to 'after all so I don't'.
Dictation wraps to a third line: 'file it myself three' plus streaming dots; left pane still empty.
Left pane: recording pill shows a tooltip then collapses; by frame 6602 left pane shows formatted numbered notes (pasted). Right pane keeps dictating 'Mark come back'.
Right pane dictation extends to '…he has the payroll records'; left notes unchanged.
Camera zooms from split view onto the left pane: wordmark and formatted notes enlarge to fill frame, right pane pushed off right edge; a hand-drawn green check appears lower right.
Camera pans horizontally from the left pane to the right pane: handwritten 'Built-in voice' title moves to centre and the right pane's unformatted dictated text fills the view.
PDF viewer zoom steps up (readout about 60% to 75%); page enlarges inside the viewer.
PDF zoom steps from about 75% to 93%; table moves up-left and enlarges.
Continued zoom crops away the viewer chrome and sidebar until the table fills a white canvas; a red underline starts drawing under 'Defined benefit plans'.
Red underline under the 'Defined benefit plans' header redraws into a red rectangle around the 1985 / 80 row cells.
A second red outline draws around the 2000 / 36 row cells at the bottom of the table.
Viewer continues zooming (to about 200%): two bar charts enlarge and the page text moves up.
Zoom crops the viewer away to leave Chart 1 on white; a red '14%' and a worried character with pointer stick appear right.
Lone character replaced by a tall blue 'BIG BUSINESS' tower at left and a blue pension-check at centre on white.
Pension check tumbles away to the upper right and off frame; a speech bubble 'Pension? What pension?' appears right of the tower.
Character vanishes and a handwritten text card writes on: 'It' in black then 'isn't' in red, centred on white.
Text card replaced by one large tilted blue pension-check illustration centred on white.
The pension check spins and shrinks while travelling down-left to a small size at lower left.
Red timeline line extends rightward from the black start tick.
